release_name: Multi-Document Context Manager, Cross-Project Sheet & View Transfer, In-Memory Family Authoring
highlights: Multi-Document Context Manager: Headless background opening, closing, and listing of RVT & RFA in RAM without UI blocking
Cross-Project Sheet & View Transfer Engine: Transfer ViewSheet with Titleblock, Viewport placements, 2D annotations, and detail items
Cross-Project Detail & System Type Transfer: Copy drafting views with all 2D elements and system types (WallType, FloorType) between projects
In-Memory Family Authoring: Inspect, add, and modify family parameters/formulas in RAM and reload with automatic override
Live-verified 100% on Autodesk Revit 2026 transferring Sheet A502 (Partition Types) with 5 viewports from Snowdon Towers
fixes: Added IFailuresPreprocessor (ClashWarningSwallower) to all write transactions to eliminate duplicate types/materials modal dialogs
Added watchdog auto-dismissal for modal reminder dialogs ('Project Not Saved Recently', 'Warning') in wake_revit.py
Optimized ViewSheet viewport queries using native GetAllViewports() to prevent slow scoped collector freezes on 100MB+ linked models
